one_line: Mughal princess, pilgrim, and author of the Humayun-Nama in Akbar’s court.

appearance.age_look: Mid-50s to early 60s, dignified and lightly built, with the calm bearing of an elder courtly scholar.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, soft but alert dark eyes, gently arched brows, a straight nose, faint age lines at eyes and mouth; default expression is composed and observant, with a slight knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Dark, almost black hair streaked subtly with grey, parted in the middle and gathered into a low bun at the nape; mostly hidden under a fine, translucent off-white muslin dupatta with a narrow gold border, draped over the head and shoulders in a modest Mughal court style.
appearance.costume: She wears a long, straight Mughal jama (robe) reaching mid-calf, made of soft light-cream cotton-silk with a wrap-closure fastened on the right, edged in a narrow stitched gold trim and scattered with tiny pale-gold floral sprig motifs; beneath, a sea-green ankle-length paijama (narrow trousers) slightly gathered at the ankles; over the jama she has a sleeveless, hip-length, pale-rose velvet waistcoat-like qaba with simple gold piping and small round buttons down the front; her dupatta is an off-white sheer muslin with a thin gold edging and faint pale-green woven stripes, draped over her head and falling over both shoulders and chest; she wears modest jewellery—small gold hoop earrings, a single thin gold nose ring in the left nostril, a simple pearl string necklace close to the neck, a plain gold bangle on each wrist, and soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes peeking beneath the hem.
appearance.signature: A slightly worn, leather-bound manuscript notebook held in one hand, with a reed pen tucked between her fingers, symbolising her authorship of the Humayun-Nama and her life of travel and memory.

ref_desc: Gulbadan Begum is a mid-50s Mughal princess with warm-brown oval face, dark greying hair under an off-white gold-edged dupatta, wearing a cream floral jama, sea-green paijama, pale-rose sleeveless waistcoat, simple gold jewellery, and holding a leather-bound manuscript with a reed pen.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Gulbadan Begum, a mid-50s Mughal princess and writer: she has an oval warm-brown face, gentle but keen dark eyes, faint smile lines, and dark hair subtly streaked with grey, parted in the middle and gathered into a low bun mostly concealed under a fine translucent off-white muslin dupatta with a thin gold border, draped over her head and resting over both shoulders and chest in a modest Mughal court style; she wears a long light-cream cotton-silk jama (robe) reaching mid-calf, wrapping right-over-left and fastened on the right side, its edges trimmed with a narrow gold piping and the fabric scattered with tiny pale-gold floral sprig motifs, over narrow sea-green ankle-length paijama trousers gathered slightly at the ankles; over the jama is a sleeveless, hip-length pale-rose velvet-like waistcoat with subtle sheen, simple round buttons down the front, and thin gold piping along the edges; her dupatta shows faint pale-green woven stripes when it catches the light; she is modestly adorned with small gold hoop earrings, a single thin gold nose ring in the left nostril, a short pearl string necklace close to the neck, and a plain gold bangle on each wrist, and she wears soft brown leather mojari slippers with slightly upturned toes just visible below the hem; in one hand she gently holds a slightly worn leather-bound manuscript notebook while a reed pen is tucked between her fingers, emphasising her role as author and traveller; keep the colours dominated by light cream, sea green, pale rose, off-white and warm gold, and render her with dignified, calm, scholarly energy in a consistent front-facing, three-quarter, and side pose layout suitable for repeated redrawing.
